acceptanceCriteria: When explicit `--exclude-member` values are supplied, generations with no recorded member are treated as covered by them (the caller asserts the author set) and the claim proceeds, recording that the legacy generations were covered by explicit exclusion, not by recorded members.
Without explicit exclusions the refusal is unchanged (never silently unfiltered).
The integrate-stage behaviour when there is no implement generation at all is specified and documented; if nothing exists to exclude, the claim is not refused for it.
Maintained tests cover mixed legacy/recorded generations with and without explicit exclusions, and integrate with no implement generation; the leases spec states the rule.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 from GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#623 (orchestrator triage; reporter observations on main-2fff511, not reproduced yet).

`claim --stage review --pool P --exclude-authors` refuses the whole claim with INDEPENDENCE_UNVERIFIED when any earlier generation has no recorded member (claimed before V1-0788). Explicit `--exclude-member` values supplied by the caller do not help. The same flag on an integrate claim with no recorded implement generation also refused.

title: corvint-tasks claim --exclude-authors refuses INDEPENDENCE_UNVERIFIED when any prior generation predates recorded pool members, even with explicit --exclude-member (issue #623)
